title: File:Ah-Shi-Sle-Pah (7267964400).jpg
art: John Fowler from Placitas, NM, USA
desc: This is a Wilderness Study Area on BLM land between Chaco Canyon and the Bisti badlands. The formations here are much like those in the Bisti. The area is smaller, though, and starts right where you get out of your vehicle.

title: File:Ah-shi-sle-pah WSA (9504078288).jpg
desc: The Ah-shi-sle-pah Wilderness Study Area is located in northwestern New Mexico and is a badland area of rolling water-carved clay hills. The area is rich in fossils and has little vegetation to conceal geological formations. The thin vegetation includes sagebrush, piñon-juniper, Great Basin scrublan
